source.author: Historical treatise attributed to Henry Cornelius Agrippa; Robert Turner, translator; authorship remains qualified
source.edition: Of Geomancy, in Henry Cornelius Agrippa His Fourth Book of Occult Philosophy; London: J.C. for John Harrison, 1655; original Wellcome Library copy IA b20458563, 240 PDF pages
source.rights_note: Wellcome/Commons identify this original-copy witness with Public Domain Mark. Historical text is distinct from modern transcription, art, metadata and reprint rights. Original concise facts and numeric patterns only; no PDF/OCR/illustrations redistributed.

collation.figure_table: All sixteen four-row identities visually compared with Princeton hcafig1; no selected pattern difference observed.
collation.procedure: Original pp5–7 agree with selected transcription construction and parity; rendering does not reverse logical order.
text_differences: Princeton normalizes long-s and typography. The report uses the editorial English label Judge; this release does not claim diplomatic transcription of the historical typography.
Original p8 really repeats first House for fourth Daughter in alternate projection. No silent correction; alternate projection excluded.
collation.historical_diagrams: Original p6–7 diagrams inspected as collation context; dash/star alignment is not adopted as an independently certified complete chart fixture. Bennett published dot-chart is the 15-position reference; further original diagram collation remains P1.
collation.excluded: Triplicities, signs, planets, house meanings and alternative astrological procedure not executable.
